name: Welcome Home, Master
source:
A short kinetic novel about an ex-rich boy who comes home from another unsuccessful job hunt to find his maid has spend their allotted food budget at a fancy Italian Restaurant.

[From [url=https://marionette.itch.io/welcome-home-master]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部简短的动态小说，讲述了一位前富家男孩在另一次求职失败后回家寻找女佣，在一家高档意大利餐厅花掉了分配的食物预算。

[来自[url=https://marionette.itch.io/welcome-home-master]Itch.io[/url]]
